name: Elm Company
summary: Elm Company, together with its subsidiaries, provides information security services in Saudi Arabia. It operates through Digital Business, Business Process Outsourcing, and Professional Services segments. The company provides integrated technology business solutions; advisory and professional services in data analysis and artificial intelligence; installation, maintenance, and support services; consultation services; computer system programming and consultancy; information technology services; data processing; and website hosting services.
